title: Renew GitHub Enterprise contract GH-ENT-2025-07 with audit rights and an exit clause
description: GH-ENT-2025-07 lapsed on 2026-06-30, but GitHub still hosts the mongodb-mcp-server (mcp-gateway) and onfinance-db-model-master (db-models) repos and their github-actions CI. Sign a renewal or amendment using the task 1 clauses: rightToAudit for the entity, SEBI and RBI (a SOC 2 report alone is not enough); an exit clause covering repository, issue and Actions-artefact export within a stated minimum period; data return and deletion. If GitHub refuses the audit clause, escalate to the CISO within 5 working days and record the refusal; do not close the task. Once signed, update company-profile/example-co/vendors/github.json: contract.reference, startDate, endDate (later than 2026-10-14), rightToAudit true. Validate with node .claude/scripts/validate-data.mjs. No repository or CI configuration change is part of this task.
acceptanceCriteria: A countersigned GitHub Enterprise renewal or amendment exists with an end date after 2026-10-14 and a right-to-audit clause naming the entity, SEBI and RBI.

company-profile/example-co/vendors/github.json shows the new contract.reference, contract.endDate later than 2026-10-14 and contract.rightToAudit true, and node .claude/scripts/validate-data.mjs exits 0 on that file.

verificationMethod.description: The CISO checks the signed GitHub contract against the updated github.json. Expected: reference and end date match, the audit clause is present, and no clause waives SEBI or RBI access. Fingerprint 117e4ec1... (contract-expiring) must not be re-raised when refresh-vendor-ctx runs in task 6.

rootCause.description: GitHub was bought on a US-law standalone click-through enterprise agreement with no right to audit and no renewal tracking. It lapsed while the vendor kept serving critical application repos.
